topic: Insulin resistance: the silent pre-diabetes threat
caption: Did you know 1 in 3 people have insulin resistance? 🚨 It's the silent precursor to type 2 diabetes. 💡 Here are the facts: Insulin resistance occurs when your cells stop responding to insulin, a hormone made by the pancreas that helps your body use glucose for energy. 🌟 It can lead to high blood sugar, weight gain, and increased risk of heart disease. 🤕 But there's hope - lifestyle changes like a healthy diet and regular exercise can help reverse insulin resistance! 🏋️‍♀️ Save this so you don't lose it.
